text_block_list.text:
While Mayano Top Gun was helping me
organize the reference materials—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
This is the magazine City-san's in!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
City-san is just gorgeous as always~♪
She rocks even the most revealing outfits perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...I know!
Maya just had a great idea~!"
After finishing up the paperwork, as the two of us were walking outside—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hullooo~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yukippe and City-san! Perfect tiiiming☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~!
City-san, you're a reader model, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: She knows lots of adult models, and City is super cool and mature, so—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna know the secret
to becoming a mature lady~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"A ‘mature woman,’ huh...
You really are obsessed with that, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-A mature woman?!
Hawawa...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...B-But if that's the secret to bein'
a "City Girl"... then I want ya to teach me too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ehh... even Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, sure.
Keep in mind this is just my personal theory, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there are two things I keep in mind
when working as an amateur magazine model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: One is 'Condition.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Always being in peak condition
and showing off the absolute best version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate version of me... That sounds so cool!!
And then what, and then what!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The other one is 'a sense of speed.'

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It means keeping your antennae up, catching the trends,
and riding the cutting-edge wave.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-That's so informative~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So those two things are why
City-san is always sparkling so bright~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If Maya wears this too,
maybe I can become way, way more grown up! ♪
choice_data_list: True, being in top condition is important.
True, a sense of speed is important.
True, keeping up the pace is important.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If Maya wears this too,
maybe I can become way, way more grown up! ♪
choice_data_list: True, being in top condition is important.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪
Conditioning, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Conditioning... physical training...
Yep! Maya totally gets it now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I just need to build up some stamina, right?
Isn't that right, Trainer-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go, let's go!
Watch Maya grow into an adult♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant, but...
Oh well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"She'll grow up in her own way,
so I figured it's fine."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
S-So cool...! I wanna become like
City-san real soon too.
By continuing her training to stay in peak condition, Mayano Top Gun seems to have built up solid stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~♪
A sense of speed, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: When it comes to speed... that's it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I think the teacher said before
that shuttle runs are good~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled♪ If it's got Trainer-chan's
seal of approval, there's no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Takeoff onto the track☆
I'm gonna be faster than anyone else, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san... Um, I wanna become
a "City Girl" too...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Don't worry about me.
...Give it your all out there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
All right, let's do this~!

"The shuttle run to build up speed
seems to have been great training for Mayano Top Gun."
